question: India has a parliamentary form of government which is a feature borrowed from the ________ Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __** Britain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's parliamentary form **of government is heavily influenced by the **British parliamentary **system, which was introduced during the** colonial period.**
 
• The Indian Constitution lays down the framework for the parliamentary system, which is based on the **Westminster model **of the British Parliament.
 
• The Indian Parliament consists of two houses, the **Lok Sabha **and the **Rajya Sabha, **which are similar to the **House of Commons** and the **House of Lords** in the **British Parliament.**
 
• The **Indian Prime Minister** is the **head of the government** and is selected by the majority party or coalition in the Lok Sabha, similar to the role of the British Prime Minister.
 
• The British Constitution is an **unwritten constitution**, which means that it is **not codified** in a single document.
 
• Instead, it is based on a collection of **laws, customs, and conventions** that have evolved over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **South Africa **has a parliamentary system of government, but it is **not** based on the British model.

 
 
• The South African Constitution was adopted in **1996 **and is a hybrid of **parliamentary and presidential** systems.
 
 
 
• The **United States** has a** presidential system** of government, which is based on the separation of powers between the **executive, legislative, and judicial branches** of government.
 
 
• The US Constitution was adopted in **1787** and is the **oldest written** constitution in the world.
 
 
 
• **Australia **also has a **parliamentary system** of government, but it is a hybrid of the **British and American models.**
 
 
• The Australian Constitution was adopted in **1901 **and is based on the Westminster model of the British Parliament, but it also incorporates elements of **federalism and separation of powers.**
